name: Maladomini
title: Maladomini: The Seventh Layer
description: Maladomini is the seventh layer of the Nine Hells, a barren landscape scarred by countless forgotten ruins, abandoned mines, and gruesome subterranean dungeons.
wiki: Maladomini is ruled by Baalzebul, the Lord of Lies, from the city of Malagard. The layer is a testament to Baalzebul's obsession with perfection, as he constantly orders the construction of new cities, only to abandon them when they fail to meet his impossible standards.
